name: GNG Ecosystem – SEO, Cache & AI Feeds
author: Robson Silva Moreira

sections.description:
GNG Ecosystem – SEO, Cache & AI Feeds is an enterprise-grade plugin designed to bridge the gap between traditional WordPress stores and modern AI ecosystems.

Built with High-Performance Edge Computing in mind, this plugin generates optimized XML, CSV, and JSON-LD feeds for your WooCommerce catalog without overloading your server.

Key Features:

  • Omnichannel AI Feeds: Seamlessly integrate your product catalog with ChatGPT, Google Gemini, Google Merchant Center, and Meta Commerce.
  • Zero-Latency Performance: Designed to work alongside Cloudflare Workers, ensuring your server memory remains intact while feeds are generated dynamically.
  • SEO & Cache Ready: Structured microdata and Edge cache compatibility to boost your organic rankings and Google News presence.
  • Security First: Built with strict sanitization and WordPress core compliance.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/gng-ecosystem-seo-cache-ai-feeds directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the GNG Ecosystem settings panel to configure your feed preferences.
  4. Add the shortcode [gngeco_selo_confianca] to your pages to display the trust badge.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin overload my server?

No. It is specifically engineered to generate feeds efficiently, minimizing database queries and memory usage.

Do I need a Cloudflare account?

While highly recommended for maximum Edge performance and security, it is not strictly required for basic feed generation.
